entries.text: - **The paper chip no longer sits on the terminal's own buy.** Compact Padre trenches pills read "1" with a lightning icon — no "SOL" text — so the matcher missed them and dropped our P 0.1 on top of the native ⚡ 1. It now recognizes those compact amounts and sits to the left of the real button. - **Chip buy, then open the chart: the entry is there.** Opening the coin mid-fill used to kill the list tab before the bag landed, and even a fill that did persist was keyed by the pair so the chart looked up the mint and drew nothing. The list now stashes the quote with the click; the chart commits it and reloads the wallet before healing stand-in keys, so the line and the entry are on the chart when you land.
